# Tile

## Tile family

One `View` on the layer groups related content; the interactive rows draw
the same box over a press target.

### Decisions

The rows carry no roster flags. The focus ring draws the tile's own
`tile_focus` / `tile_focus_width` cells as an inset outline (the upstream
edge outline), since no generic inset-ring machinery exists; a disabled
ClickableTile hides its icon seat rather than drawing the disabled glyph,
matching upstream where no glyph renders.

### Platform

`platform.support` is `both`: the rows render on the web and natively from
the same source; hover and focus are the web's states and the press target
is the platform Pressable.

## ClickableTile

ClickableTile is a tile that acts as one link or press target, with an optional corner icon.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `press` |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `node` | no | The content the tile groups. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Whether the tile takes no press and draws the disabled cells. |
| `href` | `string` | no | A link target; without it the tile acts as a button. |
| `icon` | `string` | no | A glyph name drawn in the bottom end corner. |
| `onPress` | `function` | no | Called on press when the tile has no href. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the tile. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `padding` | `control.tile_padding` |
| `minHeight` | `control.tile_min_height` |
| `minWidth` | `control.tile_min_width` |
| `focusWidth` | `control.link_focus_width` |
| `iconSize` | `control.tile_icon_size` |
| `iconInset` | `control.tile_icon_inset` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"children":"Tile content","href":"#"}` |
| disabled | `{"children":"Tile content","disabled":true}` |
| icon | `{"children":"Tile content","icon":"arrow_right"}` |
| iconDisabled | `{"children":"Tile content","disabled":true,"icon":"arrow_right"}` |

## ExpandableTile

ExpandableTile is a tile that reveals its below-the-fold content when expanded from its chevron.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `press`, `controllable-state` |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `below` | `node` | no | The content the fold reveals. |
| `children` | `node` | no | The content always visible above the fold. |
| `defaultExpanded` | `boolean` | no | The initial expanded state for the uncontrolled form. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Whether the tile takes no press and draws the disabled cells. |
| `expanded` | `boolean` | no | The expanded state for the controlled form. |
| `interactive` | `boolean` | no | Whether the content holds its own controls; then the chevron alone toggles. |
| `onToggle` | `function` | no | Called with the new expanded state on toggle. |
| `tileMaxHeight` | `number` | no | The collapsed height in points, overriding the measured fold. |
| `tilePadding` | `number` | no | The collapsed padding allowance, overriding the theme padding. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the tile. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `padding` | `control.tile_padding` |
| `minHeight` | `control.tile_min_height` |
| `minWidth` | `control.tile_min_width` |
| `focusWidth` | `control.tile_focus_width` |
| `chevronSeat` | `control.tile_chevron_seat` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"below":"Below the fold content","children":"Above the fold content"}` |
| expanded | `{"below":"Below the fold content","children":"Above the fold content","expanded":true}` |
| interactive | `{"belowLink":true,"interactive":true,"below":"Below the fold link","children":"Above the fold content"}` |

## RadioTile

RadioTile is a selectable tile that acts as one radio option inside a TileGroup.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `controllable-state`, `roving-tab-index` |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `node` | no | The content the tile groups. |
| `checked` | `boolean` | no | The checked state for the controlled form; a group injects it. |
| `defaultChecked` | `boolean` | no | The initial checked state for the uncontrolled form. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Whether the tile takes no press and draws the disabled cells. |
| `name` | `string` | no | The group name the option answers to; a group injects it. |
| `value` | `string` | no | The value this option contributes when selected. |
| `onChange` | `function` | no | Called with the new checked state on selection; a group injects it. |
| `onGroupFocus` | `function` | no | Called on focus; a group injects it to track the tab stop. |
| `focusable` | `boolean` | no | Whether the tile holds the group's tab stop; a group injects it. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the tile. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `padding` | `control.tile_padding` |
| `minHeight` | `control.tile_min_height` |
| `minWidth` | `control.tile_min_width` |
| `focusWidth` | `control.tile_focus_width` |
| `borderWidth` | `control.tile_border_width` |
| `markSpace` | `control.tile_mark_space` |
| `markSize` | `control.tile_mark_size` |
| `markInset` | `control.tile_mark_inset` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| checked | `{"checked":true,"children":"Tile content","value":"one"}` |
| unchecked | `{"children":"Tile content","value":"one"}` |

## TileGroup

TileGroup is a labelled group of RadioTiles holding one selected value.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `controllable-state`, `radio-group` |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | `array` | yes | The options: `{ value, children, disabled }` entries, one RadioTile each. |
| `defaultSelected` | `string` | no | The initially selected value for the uncontrolled form. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Whether every tile in the group is disabled. |
| `legend` | `string` | no | The label that names the group. |
| `name` | `string` | no | The name every tile answers to. |
| `onChange` | `function` | no | Called with the new selected value. |
| `valueSelected` | `string` | no | The selected value for the controlled form. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the group. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `legendGap` | `spacing.spacing_03` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"defaultSelected":"one","items":[{"children":"Option one","value":"one"},{"children":"Option two","value":"two"},{"children":"Option three","disabled":true,"value":"three"}],"legend":"Tile group","name":"sample-tile-group"}` |
